$sources: NCh 433 Mod.2009 4.3 and Table 6.1: the occupancy categories I-IV and the importance factor I
source: NCh 433 Table 6.1: category I (low risk to life, I = 0.6), II (ordinary buildings, 1.0), III (buildings with many occupants, 1.2), IV (essential and government buildings, 1.2). SAEngine's categories I-IV are the code's. The wind importance stays 1.0.

I.description: Category I: buildings of low risk to human life (agricultural, temporary) (I = 0.6)

II.description: Category II: ordinary buildings (dwellings, offices, shops) (I = 1.0)

III.description: Category III: buildings with many occupants (theatres, stadiums, schools, prisons) (I = 1.2)

IV.description: Category IV: essential and government buildings (hospitals, fire and police stations, emergency facilities) (I = 1.2)
